blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Lincoln Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Lincoln Park, Port Coquitlam: 12 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 6 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Lincoln Park fell from 15 in June to 12 in September (−20.0%), and 5 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.8% of Port Coquitlam’s 153 houses listed.

blocks.text: Lincoln Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

13 houses sold in Lincoln Park with a median price of $1,290,000 (the middle half sold between $1,165,000 and $1,400,000), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $576 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 12 houses listed in Lincoln Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Lincoln Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Lincoln Park had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Lincoln Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in Lincoln Park over those 4 months, out of 72 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Lincoln Park sell for?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Lincoln Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,290,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Lincoln Park?
faq.a: The median was 34 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.9% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
